rows.label: tlk70000014_03_msg0001
rows.name:
I'm not sure how much it comes
across, but it takes a lot for
me to put my trust in someone.

rows.label: tlk70000014_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Even someone who looks kind and gentle
on the outside could be thinking
anything inside, right?

rows.label: tlk70000014_03_msg0003
rows.name:
They might mean harm, or be hiding
some ulterior motive.

rows.label: tlk70000014_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Maybe I'm just not a very good judge
of character. It's hard for me to see
through to a person's true nature...

rows.label: tlk70000014_03_msg0005
rows.name:
I was cheated out of money once. It's
been years, and I tried to forget it
as a lesson, but I just can't.

rows.label: tlk70000014_03_msg0006
rows.name:
But I realized what's even worse is me
staying negative forever.

rows.label: tlk70000014_03_msg0007
rows.name:
So I'll try little by little. I don't
want another mess like this one.
